default.name: Local Emergency Services
default.text: If you are in distress or need immediate support, please reach out to your local emergency services, a crisis hotline in your area, or a trusted person.

US.name: Suicide & Crisis Lifeline
US.text: In the US, you can call or text 988 (available 24/7, free, confidential) or contact emergency services at 911.

CA.name: Suicide Crisis Helpline
CA.text: In Canada, you can call or text 988 (available 24/7, bilingual, free) or contact emergency services at 911.

UK.name: Samaritans & NHS
UK.text: In the UK, you can call Samaritans at 116 123, call NHS mental health services at 111, or call 999 for emergencies.

EU.name: European Emergency Services
EU.text: In the EU, you can dial 112 for emergency assistance or connect with local crisis support lines in your country.

AU.name: Lifeline Australia
AU.text: In Australia, you can call Lifeline at 13 11 14 or emergency services at 000.
